Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Redeploy a lab virtual machine

Body.Content:
As a lab user, you can now redeploy a lab virtual machine so that you don't waste time troubleshooting your remote desktop connection or application access to a Windows-based Azure virtual machine.

To learn more about this feature, go to our team blog.
